title: Session Handoff
description: Prepare for the next session or model. Commit, score, document what was learned, update flows.

nodes.label: Commit all work with descriptive message
nodes.detail: Include before/after scores in commit message. Separate commits for different concerns.

nodes.label: Run baseline scoring
nodes.detail: Save to doc/reports/baseline_scores_YYYY-MM-DD.json. This is the proof of progress.

nodes.label: Did you discover new thinking paths?
nodes.detail: Any debugging pattern, workflow optimization, or decision tree you built during the session.

nodes.label: Save new flows to .claude/flows/
nodes.detail: POST /api/flows with the new flow JSON. Update INDEX.md.

nodes.label: Update handover doc
nodes.detail: doc/VISUAL_IMPROVEMENT_HANDOVER.md or doc/ARTIFACT_IMPROVEMENT_HANDOVER.md. What's done, what's next, what was learned.

nodes.label: Update memory if needed
nodes.detail: Save to .claude/projects/*/memory/ if there are persistent facts the next session needs.

nodes.label: Session complete — next model can pick up

summary: Commit → score baseline → save new flows from discoveries → update handover doc → update memory.
